baby brother: My baby brother is only two years old, but he loves to sing songs.
我的小弟弟只有两岁,但他喜欢唱歌。
football player: His dream is to become a football player for the national team one day.
他的梦想是有一天能成为国家队的一名足球运动员。
eat breakfast: I usually eat breakfast at seven o'clock before I go to school.
我通常七点吃早饭,然后去上学。
have...class: We have an English class every Monday morning, and I really enjoy it.
我们每周一早上上英语课,我真的很喜欢。
play sports: Many students play sports after school to stay healthy and make friends.
许多学生放学后进行体育运动,以保持健康并结交朋友。
do morning exercise: My grandfather gets up early to do morning exercise in the park.
我爷爷起得很早,去公园做早操。
eat dinner: Our family likes to eat dinner together and talk about our day.
我们一家人喜欢一起吃晚饭,聊聊各自的一天。
clean my room: I have to clean my room before my friends come over this afternoon.
今天下午朋友们来之前,我得打扫我的房间。
go for a walk: After supper, we often go for a walk along the river near our home.
晚饭后,我们经常在自家附近的河边散步。
go shopping: Mother will go shopping for some new clothes this weekend.
妈妈这个周末要去买一些新衣服。
take a dancing class: My sister takes a dancing class every Saturday afternoon at the school gym.
我姐姐每周六下午在学校体育馆上舞蹈课。
The train leaves at 8 a.m., so we must get up very early.
火车上午八点发车,所以我们必须很早起床。
The library closes at 9 p.m. on weekdays, so we have enough time to study.
图书馆工作日下午九点关门,所以我们有足够的时间学习。
go swimming: When summer comes, children often go swimming in the cool river.
夏天来的时候,孩子们经常去凉爽的河里游泳。
go on a picnic: We plan to go on a picnic in the mountains next Sunday if the weather is fine.
如果天气好,我们计划下周日去山里野餐。
pick apples: In autumn, farmers pick apples and send them to the market.
秋天,农民们摘苹果并把它们送到市场。
make a snowman: The children went out to make a snowman after the heavy snow stopped.
大雪停后,孩子们出去堆雪人。
On hot days, my friends and I like to go swimming in the sea.
炎热的天气里,我和朋友们喜欢去海里游泳。
good job: You did a good job on the exam, so your parents are proud of you.
你考试考得很好,所以你的父母为你感到骄傲。
a few: There are a few apples left in the basket, so we can share them.
篮子里还剩几个苹果,我们可以分着吃。
sports meet: Our school will hold a sports meet on the playground next month.
我们学校下个月将在操场上举行运动会。
the Great Wall: Last year, my family visited the Great Wall and took many photos there.
去年,我们全家参观了长城,在那里拍了很多照片。
National Day: We have a seven-day holiday to celebrate National Day every October.
每年十月我们都有七天假期来庆祝国庆节。
look for: I am looking for my English book, but I can't find it anywhere.
我正在找我的英语书,可是到处都找不到。
each other: The two friends helped each other with their homework after class.
这两个朋友课后互相帮助做作业。
doing morning exercises: Look! The students are doing morning exercises on the playground now.
看!学生们现在正在操场上做早操。
having...class: The children are having a science class in the new lab this morning.
孩子们今天上午在新实验室上科学课。
eating lunch: We are eating lunch in the dining hall because it is raining outside.
因为外面在下雨,我们正在食堂吃午饭。
reading a book: My father is reading a book about history in the living room.
我爸爸正在客厅里读一本关于历史的书。
listening to music: She is listening to music with her headphones while doing her homework.
她一边做作业,一边戴着耳机听音乐。
keep to the right: When you walk on the road, you should keep to the right for safety.
在路上行走时,为了安全你应该靠右走。
keep your desk clean: Please keep your desk clean and put everything in the right place.
请保持课桌干净,把东西都放整齐。
talk quietly: Students should talk quietly in the library so they don't disturb others.
学生在图书馆里应该小声讲话,以免打扰别人。
take turns: There is only one computer, so we have to take turns to use it.
只有一台电脑,所以我们得轮流使用。
have a look: The teacher asked us to have a look at the map before the trip.
老师让我们在出发前先看一看地图。
post office: I need to go to the post office to send this letter to my grandmother.
我需要去邮局把这封信寄给我奶奶。
on foot: My home is near the school, so I go there on foot every day.
我家离学校很近,所以我每天步行去上学。
slow down: The driver had to slow down because there were many people crossing the road.
司机不得不慢下来,因为有许多人正在过马路。
pay attention to: Please pay attention to the new words when you read the text.
traffic lights: You must stop at the traffic lights when they turn red.
交通信号灯变红时,你必须停下来。
